answersJson.title: Answers JSON
answersJson.description: Current accumulated answers JSON. Pass from the latest SmartIntake action output.

matchFieldKey.title: Match Field Key
matchFieldKey.description: Metadata field key used for matching, for example guestName or email. Use the matching key configured for the current question.

matchValue.title: Match Value
matchValue.description: User-provided value to search for in existing Salesforce records. Usually pass the current answer value.

templateKey.title: Template Key
templateKey.description: Metadata template key for the intake form, for example HOTEL_BOOKING_BASIC_V1.
